result: Optional passthrough@1 memory extraction, common record_fact, Project Facts UI and existing Finding correlation/retention work together through real Server, PostgreSQL and Runtime. The model describes a fact freely and selects memory_name; Runtime attaches the selected original deterministically. No quote checker, separate Fact store or extraction-only creation tool remains.

checks.database: unset for this final static check after completed real-store release verification and cleanup

ui.responsive_review: All six retained source-detail screenshots inspected at 390/1440 px in light/dark/black; no layout issue.

additional_full_gate_coverage: Both Go race groups, all touched packages, filesystem backend packages, generated public clients, catalog locks/config validation, layers and strict schemas passed.
Compaction verifier confirmed five selected process cases; Findings verifier passed after the final process shard.
mechanism_evidence: Real memory writer -> model-free snapshot operation -> separate passthrough@1 Stage, exactly one Runtime Worker and no Planner LLM. Unknown memory_name rejects before intake; free-form descriptions retain the exact original memory.
Actual public Finding collection selects one exact receipt, downloads its ZIP and checks original memory bytes. Later memory updates do not rewrite retained sources.

Equal complete evidence content sets share one informational Finding across new calls/attempts while preserving independent receipts. Same-call replay adds no receipt. Titles do not participate. Non-informational correlation remains unchanged.

A real PostgreSQL Audit A fact is selected into Audit B hypothesis grounds. Purging A and its Run preserves B grounds and Project sources; purging B releases its registry/grounds, and Project materials survive. Existing Project purge coverage drains owned data.

Existing cancellation, claim fencing, response recovery, source pagination and scale paths pass. Facts UI is a severity-filtered view of the existing Finding reader; analyst severity changes membership without changing identity.
Ordinary finding, HTTP finding, record_fact and Caido discovery/inspection/replay use local request_id. Provider identifiers stay within adapters/provenance.
The native Audit Eval member publishes a fact into its isolated execution Project and exact Project navigation works, with cross-owner denials intact.

quality.fixture_validation: All six memory inputs pass the production Runtime selector; private expectations stay outside model input. The recipe and actual scripted Audit Eval path pass.
quality.human_review: A separate explicitly run repeated live Eval and human review are still needed for semantic-quality conclusions.

skips: No required fact/UI/process case was skipped. Four named integration disk-heavy skips, seventeen unit case skip events, 135 Runtime skips and one optional shared fixture disk-heavy skip are recorded separately and are not passing coverage. No heavy-I/O opt-in was enabled.
accepted_approximation: Different claims over the same complete evidence contents can share a card; changed evidence bytes can create separate cards. Independent receipts retain their original claim and exact sources. No title, provider, semantic or material-group matching is added.
